name: OpenEuroLLM Winter School
venue: Skeikampen Conference Hotel, near Oslo, Norway
description: The 2026 Winter School on Multilinguality in LLM Development and Evaluation is organized by the Nordic Language Processing Laboratory and the University of Oslo and takes place at the Skeikampen conference hotel north of Oslo, Norway. It targets NLP researchers, especially those from EuroHPC consortium countries, and offers doctoral training with in‑depth technical talks, hands‑on elements, and discussions on multilingual large language models and their evaluation. The program includes presentations by international experts, a walk‑through of EuroHPC experience reports, and networking opportunities, all provided free of charge aside from travel and accommodation costs.

name: Probabilistic AI School
description: The ProbAI School 2026 is a probabilistic AI summer school taking place in Vilnius, Lithuania. It aims to provide an inclusive educational environment covering state‑of‑the‑art machine‑learning and artificial‑intelligence topics for enthusiasts, students, academics and industry professionals. The event is co‑organized with the Artificial Intelligence Association of Lithuania (AIAL).

name: BMVA Computer Vision Summer School
venue: Robert Gordon University, Aberdeen, Scotland, United Kingdom
description: The 30th BMVA Computer Vision Summer School will be held at Robert Gordon University in Aberdeen, Scotland. It offers an intensive week of lectures and lab sessions covering a wide range of topics in computer vision, delivered by leading researchers from the UK and abroad. The programme spans five days of oral talks each day, providing participants with deep, hands‑on exposure to current advances in the field.

name: Oxford Machine Learning Summer School 2026
venue: Oxford Machine Learning School, Oxford, United Kingdom
description: OxML 2026 is the Oxford Machine Learning School held in Oxford, United Kingdom, offering three advanced machine‑learning programmes. The programmes cover building AI models from scratch (MLx Cases), applying representation learning and generative AI to health and biomedical challenges (MLx Health & Bio), and exploring the latest advances in representation learning and frontier AI (MLx Representation Learning & Gen AI). The school combined online and hybrid formats, featuring leading researchers and hands‑on projects for participants.

name: Robotics, Perception and Learning (RPL) Summer School
venue: KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm, Sweden
description: The RPL Summer School 2026 is a six‑day event for doctoral and postdoctoral researchers organized by the Department for Robotics, Perception and Learning at KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm, Sweden. It covers a broad spectrum of topics in robotics, perception and learning, including machine learning, computer vision, human‑robot interaction, planning and decision making, and combines keynote talks, industry panels and brainstorming sessions. The program is held at the Happy Tammsvik resort and aims to foster new collaborations through discussions, presentations and outdoor ice‑breaker activities.

name: Machine Learning Crash Course at MALGA
description: The MLCC2026 Summer School – Machine Learning Crash Course – provides an introduction to fundamental machine‑learning concepts and algorithms. It is aimed at undergraduate and graduate students, as well as professionals, and is open to participants from any university after a selection process. The five‑day in‑person program in Genoa combines theoretical lectures with hands‑on lab sessions and includes a final test consisting of notebook work and a report.

name: UK Robotics Summer School
venue: National Robotarium, Heriot-Watt University, Edinburgh, United Kingdom
description: The UK Robotics Summer School is a five‑day program held at the National Robotarium, Heriot‑Watt University in Edinburgh, United Kingdom. It offers expert‑led lectures, tutorials, industry talks and hands‑on experience with state‑of‑the‑art robotics technology, focusing on cutting‑edge topics in the field. The school targets master’s‑level students and industry practitioners, providing networking opportunities with academics and industry leaders.

name: International Summer School for Advanced Studies on Biometrics, Behavior, and Vision
description: The 2027 Biometrics Summer School takes place at Hotel Dei Pini in Porto Conte near Alghero, Sardinia, Italy. It focuses on the impact of agentic AI and vision foundation models on biometrics, covering machine learning, image understanding, signal analysis, neuroscience, robotics, forensic and digital forensics. The program is aimed at PhD students, post‑docs, researchers, forensic examiners and professionals, offering lectures by 18 international experts, keynote talks, and optional videoconference participation.

name: Winter School on Ethical, Legal, and Societal (ELS) aspects of AI and AS at Umeå University
description: The Winter School on Ethical, Legal, and Societal (ELS) aspects of AI and Autonomous Systems focuses on the societal implications, regulatory frameworks, and ethical considerations of artificial intelligence technologies.

name: Winter School on Social Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Multimedia (SoRAIM 2026)
description: The ACM Europe Winter School SoRAIM’27 focuses on social robotics, artificial intelligence, and multimedia. It targets PhD students and early‑career researchers, offering lectures, hands‑on sessions, and informal networking in a mountain setting near Grenoble, France. The program aims to foster cross‑disciplinary exchange among experts in computer vision, speech processing, affective computing, and human‑robot interaction.

name: Northern Lights Deep Learning Winter School
venue: UiT The Arctic University of Norway, Tromsø, Norway
description: The 2027 Winter School on Deep Learning is part of the Northern Lights Deep Learning Conference in Tromsø, Norway. It runs from 11 to 15 January 2027 and focuses on state‑of‑the‑art deep‑learning techniques such as image classification, object detection, segmentation, time‑series prediction and speech recognition. The school targets researchers and practitioners who want to exchange ideas, foster collaborations, and learn about cutting‑edge research in the field.

name: Annual Nepal AI School (ANAIS)
venue: Kathmandu World School, Suryabinayanak, Kathmandu, Nepal
description: The 7th Annual Nepal AI School (ANAIS) is an 11‑day intensive in‑person program held at Kathmandu World School in Kathmandu, Nepal. It offers a broad AI curriculum covering fundamentals and advanced topics such as geometric deep learning, generative modeling, neuro‑symbolic AI, and vision‑language models, with lectures, labs, and project work. The school targets senior undergraduates, graduate students, PhD candidates, faculty, and industry professionals from South Asia and around the world.

name: EEML Summer School
venue: Eastern European Machine Learning Summer School, Cetinje, Montenegro
description: The Eastern European Machine Learning Summer School takes place in Cetinje, Montenegro from 27 July to 1 August 2026. It offers lectures and tutorials on machine learning by leading researchers from institutions such as Google DeepMind, MIT, and EPFL, targeting students and early‑career researchers in the region. The program includes a diverse lineup of speakers, hands‑on sessions, and networking opportunities, with applications already closed.

name: Mediterranean Summer School
venue: Mediterranean Machine Learning Summer School, Barcelona, Spain
description: The Mediterranean Machine Learning (M2L) Summer School 2027 is a five‑day program in Barcelona, Spain, offering keynotes, lectures and practical sessions on AI. It targets doctoral and outstanding master students, academics and practitioners, emphasizing state‑of‑the‑art topics such as computer vision, natural language processing, generative models and ethics in machine learning. The school promotes diversity, networking and collaboration through scholarships, poster sessions and social activities.

name: AthNLP Summer School 2026
description: The Athens Natural Language Processing Summer School 2026 (AthNLP) is a week‑long program held at the NCSR Demokritos campus in Athens, Greece. It brings together experts from institutions such as RC Athena, NCSR Demokritos, Athens University of Economics and Business, Heriot‑Watt University and ELLIS‑Manchester to deliver lectures and hands‑on sessions on modern NLP techniques. The school targets graduate students and early‑career researchers and is scheduled for 2–8 September 2026, preceding the 14th EETN Conference on AI in Chania.

name: Advanced Artificial Intelligence: GenAI & Deep Unsupervised Learning
venue: Lady Margaret Hall, Oxford, United Kingdom
description: The AI For Finance summer school is a three‑week residential or online course offered by Lady Margaret Hall, University of Oxford. It explores how artificial intelligence techniques such as neural networks, time‑series forecasting, reinforcement learning and agentic AI are applied to quantitative finance, risk management, trading and portfolio optimisation. The programme is aimed at students and aspiring finance professionals who want to gain practical skills in AI‑driven financial modelling and understand the limitations and risks of frontier technologies.

name: LUT Summer School
description: LUT Summer School is a one‑week academic event that offers intensive courses covering sustainability, climate action, marketing, management and inventive thinking at the intersection of business and technology. The programme combines on‑campus workshops, classes and group work with online learning and a social programme set in the Finnish summer on the Lappeenranta campus. It targets bachelor’s and master’s students from partner universities who wish to gain interdisciplinary knowledge and experience Finnish nature and culture.

name: 1st Internationa School on the Cognitive, Ethical, and Societal Dimensions of AI - AIces
description: AIces 2026 is the inaugural International School on the Cognitive, Ethical and Societal Dimensions of Artificial Intelligence, held in Porto–Maia, Portugal from 30 March to 2 April 2026. The four‑day program offers parallel multidisciplinary courses, a symposium of short presentations, and open‑debate sessions, with both on‑site attendance and live online participation and recordings available for 45 days. It is aimed at graduate and postgraduate students as well as industry practitioners interested in the foundations, challenges and societal impacts of AI.

name: Summer School on Multimodal Foundation Models and Generative AI
venue: Institut National des Postes et Télécommunications, Rabat, Morocco
description: The AI Summer School on Multimodal Foundation Models and Generative AI is a five‑day immersive program held at the Institut National des Postes et Télécommunications in Rabat, Morocco. It targets young researchers, Ph.D. and master students, post‑docs and professionals, offering theoretical lectures, hands‑on labs, and project mentorship on state‑of‑the‑art multimodal and generative AI. The school features expert speakers, networking opportunities, and aims to build the next generation of AI leaders in Morocco through partnerships with MoroccoAI, IMT Nord Europe and industry sponsors.

name: AI4Science Summer School
description: The 2nd Summer School on Advancing Scientific Discovery with AI brings together researchers, PhD students and post‑doctoral scholars to explore how artificial intelligence can accelerate scientific research. It covers topics such as machine‑learning for data analysis, AI‑driven experimental design, generative models, and the integration of AI with physical simulations, featuring hands‑on workshops using Python libraries like NumPy and PyTorch. The program aims to equip participants with practical skills and interdisciplinary insights to apply AI techniques to their own scientific investigations.
